IGUI_KnoxPass_OpenTip: Works if the owner shares this gate with your faction or safehouse; otherwise you need a Knox Pass tag registered to this reader, with charge left, in your inventory, or a registered watch module that is working.
IGUI_KnoxPass_OtherOwnerTip: To manage this gate, ask the owner to add you under Co-managers: by account, faction or safehouse.
IGUI_KnoxPass_NeedFramework: The management window needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework (MinidoracatUIFor42).
IGUI_KnoxPass_NoPower: No power (needs grid power or a generator)
IGUI_KnoxPass_LockUnsupported: This gate does not support the Knox Pass lock
IGUI_KnoxPass_ConfirmUnregister: Unregister the selected items (%1)? To let them open the gate again, bring the vehicle or the person wearing the module within 15 tiles of the gate and register again.
IGUI_KnoxPass_ConfirmRemove: Remove this reader? All registered vehicles will be cleared and the reader goes back to your inventory.
IGUI_KnoxPass_RetryHint: Retries automatically within 3 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_NoTags: No vehicles or watch modules registered yet. Check them under Nearby, then press Register.
IGUI_KnoxPass_NoNearby: No unregistered vehicles and no one wearing a watch module within 15 tiles.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_InVehicle: Get out of the vehicle first.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Unverified: Your identity could not be verified (split-screen players 2-4 cannot manage readers).
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_TooFar: Stand within 3 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Safehouse: You can't do that in someone else's safehouse.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_AlreadyInstalled: This gate already has a Knox Pass reader.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotOwner: Only the reader's owner, a co-manager or a server admin can do that. Ask one of them.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_VehicleTooFar: The vehicle must be within 15 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoTag: This vehicle has no Knox Pass tag installed.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotRegistered: This vehicle's tag is not registered at this gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_TooMany: This reader can register up to 64 items (vehicles and watch modules combined). Unregister ones you no longer use first.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoLockSupport: This gate does not support the Knox Pass lock.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoSpeedSupport: This gate's opening speed cannot be changed.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NeedFlash: Flash your headlights first: press %1 twice quickly.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotAllowed: This gate isn't shared with your faction or safehouse, and you have no registered Knox Pass tag or watch module that works.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoPower: The reader has no power. The gate needs grid power or a generator.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Blocked: Someone or something is in the gateway, or the gate is barricaded. Clear it and try again.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Busy: The gate failed to move just now; try again in a moment.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotLoaded: The gate area is not loaded. Move closer to the gate and try again.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_RateLimited: Too many requests; wait a few seconds.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_Error: Knox Pass could not complete that action. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the server admin.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_BuiltIn: This reader is built into the barrier; dismantle the barrier's cabinet instead.
IGUI_KnoxPass_AheadWarn: The Knox Pass gate ahead won't open for this vehicle: %1
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoPaint: You don't have paint in that color.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NotCarried: The item must be in your inventory (remove an installed tag with the mechanics panel first).
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_BarrierColor: The barrier's built-in reader can't be repainted.
IGUI_KnoxPass_RangeHint: Circle = range when stopped. Faster cars open sooner.

IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersNote: Co-managers can open the management window, change settings, register vehicles and lock the gate. They can't remove the reader or change this list.
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersFactionNone: Faction members (the owner is not in a faction)
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersFactionHint: People who join later count too; leaving the faction ends it
IGUI_KnoxPass_ManagersHousesHint: People who join later count too; it ends when the owner leaves that safehouse

%1
This safehouse is gone, or the owner is no longer in it. It comes back when the owner returns; turn it off to remove it.

IGUI_KnoxPass_PickCandidate: Pick a player from the suggestions below, then press Add.
IGUI_KnoxPass_LockSafehouseOnly: This server only allows locking gates in the owner's safehouse
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_OwnerOnly: Only the reader's owner or a server admin can do that.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_UnknownPlayer: This server doesn't know a player with that account name (exact name, case-sensitive). Pick from the suggestions below the box, or wait until they have been online once.

IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_NoHouse: The reader's owner isn't in that safehouse, or it's gone. Reopen this list to see the current ones.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_InstallSafehouseOnly: On this server you can only install readers in your own safehouse.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_LockSafehouseOnly: On this server only gates in the owner's safehouse can be locked.
IGUI_KnoxPass_WatchModule_Desc: Register this module at a gate reader, then walk toward that gate and it opens by itself. It works while driving too, in any vehicle. The minimap marks the registered gates.
IGUI_KnoxPass_WalkWarn: The gate did not open for you: %1
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_WatchOff: Your watch module isn't working: wear the watch, replace its battery, or check the slot on the watch panel.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_WearerTooFar: The person wearing the module must be within 15 tiles of the gate.
IGUI_KnoxPass_ModIdle: Watch has no power or the slot is off
IGUI_KnoxPass_Walk: Registered watch modules open it on approach
IGUI_KnoxPass_WalkOff: Watch modules open it on approach (off on this server)
IGUI_KnoxPass_Indestructible: Indestructible (zombies and weapons can't break it)
IGUI_KnoxPass_IndestructibleAll: Indestructible (the server turned it on for every gate)
IGUI_KnoxPass_IndoorFramed: Counts as indoors (doors in frames already do)
IGUI_KnoxPass_IndoorUnsupported: Counts as indoors (not for this gate)
IGUI_KnoxPass_IndoorTip: This gate always counts as a wall, even when open. Once the walls and roof are finished, the room counts as indoors.
IGUI_KnoxPass_IndoorTipCut: This gate always counts as a wall, even when open. Once the walls and roof are finished, the room counts as indoors. When the gate blocks your view of your character, it is cut away like a wall.
IGUI_KnoxPass_DurabilityTip: A server admin can make a gate indestructible (neither zombies nor weapons break it): this gate in this window, or every gate under Sandbox Options.
IGUI_KnoxPass_Why_AdminOnly: Only a server admin can change Indestructible.

IGUI_KnoxPass_RoadText_tooltip: The boom barrier and the double boom barrier have KNOX PASS painted on the road, so players can tell the gate stops vehicles. Untick to hide the text on your own screen only. The white stop line stays.
IGUI_KnoxPass_WhatsNew: KNOX PASS road text at barriers can now be hidden: untick it in the Options MODS tab.
